notes.title: Update on Vive Support
notes.notes:
I installed the latest Unity 5.4 Beta last night which is now RC1, everything seems to be working OK. I need to re bake all the scenes and then I should be able to make a new build that has native OpenVR included.

I had a look at integrating the Lab Renderer but I couldn't get it to work properly and it requires OpenVR exclusively which isn't something I am willing to support at the expense of the Rifts ATW.

There should be some perf improvements from 5.4 Single Pass Stereo but on a min spec VR machine you're likely to average around 70+ FPS. Without the Rifts ATW I'm not yet sure how juddery this will feel.

notes.title: Timeouts after Spawning & Version 1.86
notes.notes:
If you've been kicked out of a Server or seen players getting Timeout notices in the chat channel I have added a fix which should finally resolve this.

There is now a new option in the Multiplayer Options to only use TCP instead of UDP. This is enabled by default, TCP is much more reliable than UDP but can incur some lag if packets are lost and don't arrive as it will request a resend until they arrive ok.

UDP is only used for the synchronisation of the position of the Player and Missiles as this can tollerate some lost packets due to the way the data is interpolated. All other events are sent with TCP, this is why you can connect fine and chat but Timeout after spawning.

I had a discussion with the programmer that wrote the Networking framework Lunar Flight uses (TNet) and the reason this is happening is that for some reason the UDP data transfer doesn't send packets through on some peoples machines. He is going to investigate this and see if there is an issue in his code that needs addressing.

notes.title: Version 1.67 now available!
notes.notes:
Last Update: 2nd January 2013

Small update out today, version 1.67. 
The main change is that the Launcher no longer shows and 
instead the game starts up straight away. 

There is now an 'Options' button on the Start screen 
where you can configure Audio, Graphics & Controls. 
This was done for two reasons. 

1: The latest version of Unity introduced an annoying bug that 
would always reset the the selected resolution to the 
default 1280x720. This occurred when the launcher started. 
There is a build option to hide the launcher which prevents 
it from changing the last resolution selection.

2: Now that it is possible to fully configure the Graphics and 
Controls in game the launcher is no longer required.

On PC the Alternate Controls Column is only populated with X360
controlls if one is detected. It will also assign the correct 
device ID if it is not the first device. Reset To Defaults also
does this.

notes.title: Lunar Flight v1.6 Mars Update Now Available!
notes.notes:
New Ambient Music Track by Jason Poots
New Highest Rank - Level 8 'Elite' 500,000 XP
6 New Achievements

New Mars Map including: 
- Simulated Mars physics, Gravity, Atmospheric pressure
- Dynamic Dustorm System
- Crosswind forces
- 12 Time Trial Routes with Leaderboards
- 16 Survey Locations
- 10 Cargo Locations

A new Mars Free Flight Replay Demo is included if you
just want to jump in and check out Mars.

Version 1.6 also includes several bug fixes & optimisations
